name: pharmastock
description: PharmaStock — professional pharmacy inventory management system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install
